_about: The first minute against the first rival (scripts/lessons.gd): each step is shown once with a held wind-up and a cue read before the blow; one retry; then he fights for real. read_frames: the cue is up this long before he strikes. hold: extra wind-up frames at the coil (a slower, readable blow). open_frames: how long he stands open after the right answer. max_frames: the lessons end by this round frame whatever happened.
done: That is all he knows. Now he fights for real.

steps.cue: He raises the mace: HOLD SPACE (or L) to block it.
steps.next_cue: Blocked! He bounced off your guard: hit him NOW (LMB / J).

steps.cue: Watch for the glint on his mace, then TAP SPACE as it lands: PARRY.
steps.next_cue: PARRY! He is thrown open: a HEAVY (RMB / K) cannot miss.

steps.cue: He hides behind his shield. E: your shoulder breaks a guard.
